_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: cards_item
data.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX cards_item ON cards (item_id, drill_type, IFNULL(tense, ''))

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'official', "retired" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("retired" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "everyday" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("everyday" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "nouns" ("source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'official', "retired" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("retired" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "word" TEXT NOT NULL, "gender" TEXT NOT NULL, "elides" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("elides" IN (0, 1)), "plural_only" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("plural_only" IN (0, 1)), "definition" TEXT NULL, "gloss" TEXT NULL, "synonyms" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "ending_hint" TEXT NULL, "level" TEXT NULL, "rank" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "noun_categories" ("source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'official', "retired" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("retired" IN (0, 1)), "noun_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nouns (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), PRIMARY KEY ("noun_id", "category_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "noun_examples" ("source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'official', "retired" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("retired" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "noun_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nouns (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "example_text" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "verbs" ("source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'official', "retired" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("retired" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "infinitive" TEXT NOT NULL, "group" TEXT NOT NULL, "auxiliary" TEXT NOT NULL, "pronominal" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pronominal" IN (0, 1)), "h_aspire" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("h_aspire" IN (0, 1)), "level" TEXT NOT NULL, "rank" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "verb_categories" ("source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'official', "retired" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("retired" IN (0, 1)), "verb_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES verbs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), PRIMARY KEY ("verb_id", "category_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "verb_forms" ("source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'official', "retired" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("retired" IN (0, 1)), "verb_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES verbs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "tense" TEXT NOT NULL, "person" TEXT NOT NULL, "form" TEXT NOT NULL, "alternatives" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("verb_id", "tense", "person"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sentences" ("source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'official', "retired" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("retired" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "verb_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES verbs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "tense" TEXT NOT NULL, "person" TEXT NOT NULL, "sentence_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "answer" TEXT NOT NULL, "alternatives" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "images" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES nouns (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "format" TEXT NOT NULL, "svg" TEXT NULL, "bytes" BLOB NULL, "source" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((svg IS NULL) <> (bytes IS NULL)), CHECK ((format = 'svg') = (svg IS NOT NULL)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cards" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "drill_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "tense" TEXT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new', "step" INTEGER NULL, "stability" REAL NULL, "difficulty" REAL NULL, "due" INTEGER NULL, "last_review" INTEGER NULL, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "lapses" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "again_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_leech" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_leech" IN (0, 1)), "known_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "drill_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "answered" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "correct" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "incorrect" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "review_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "card_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES cards (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id), "timestamp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "study_day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rating" INTEGER NOT NULL, "state_before" TEXT NOT NULL, "elapsed_days" INTEGER NULL, "scheduled_days" INTEGER NOT NULL, "response_time_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "typed_answer" TEXT NULL, "error_type" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "category_weights" ("drill_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("drill_type", "category_id"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX cards_item ON cards (item_id, drill_type, IFNULL(tense, ''))
